 <div data-flex-id="9df9d643" data-auto="flex-section" id="Kitesurfing" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1048005097" class="" data-anchor="Kitesurfing"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1618396994"></div> 
 <section id="71bcd224" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="a6ef08d6" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="befb395b" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="1b09f993" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="5c7ce63d" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1525644161"> <div class="dmNewParagraph skip-animation-effect skip-hover-effect" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1525644161" style=""> <h2 class="m-text-align-left text-align-center"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_4);">Bonaire Offers Perfect Wind Conditions for Kitesurfers</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="2daa57cf" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1733966437"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1733966437" data-ai-tag="Short description" style=""><p class="m-size-16 t-size-17 text-align-center m-text-align-left"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-17" style="display: initial;">Bonaire is the ultimate destination for kitesurfers, thanks to its consistent trade winds that sweep across the island. With wind speeds ranging between 15 and 25 knots and an offshore breeze, Bonaire offers ideal conditions for both beginners and experienced kitesurfers. The crystal-clear water, safe environment, and laid-back atmosphere make the island a true paradise for kiteboarding enthusiasts.</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-flex-id="90d7d6f4" data-auto="flex-section" id="1862297656" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1064588942"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1948276435"></div> 
 <section id="d6089be5" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="b33145ad" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="4d0d12bc" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="a7f629cd" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="0a2a5f8c" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1707886416"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1707886416" data-ai-tag="Short paragraph (2 sentences)" style=""> <h2> <span style="display:initial;">Kitebeach Bonaire: Atlantis</span> 
</h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="d16f99e3" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1124241519"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1124241519" data-ai-tag="Kicker" style=""><p><span style="display: unset;">Located on Bonaire&rsquo;s southwest coast, Atlantis Beach is the island&rsquo;s go-to spot for kitesurfing. This location offers flat water, wide white sandy beaches, and even the chance to spot dolphins while you ride. As if that weren&rsquo;t enough, breathtaking sunsets are a regular bonus at the end of a kitesurfing session. Did you know that Roan Jaspers, co-owner of Windhoek Resort Bonaire, was one of the pioneers of kitesurfing on the island? As the founder of Kiteboarding Bonaire in 2002, he played a major role in putting Atlantis on the map as the kitesurfing hotspot of Bonaire. Do you have any questions about kitesurfing on Bonaire? Roan is happy to share his insider tips!</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="883656c9" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section>

 <div data-flex-id="2e5727b9" data-auto="flex-section" id="1040596953" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1064588942"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1576830634"></div> 
 <section id="1346bd7f" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="f6285709" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="9e41dbc2" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="cba1f593" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19"></div> 
 <div id="74279fa9" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="b7a9642d" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1454415808"> <div class="dmNewParagraph skip-animation-effect skip-hover-effect" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1454415808" data-ai-tag="Short paragraph (2 sentences)" style=""> <h2><span style="display: initial;">Kitesurf Lessons &amp; Gear Rental</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="959a0079" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1135470048"> <div class="dmNewParagraph skip-animation-effect skip-hover-effect" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1135470048" data-ai-tag="Kicker" style=""><p><span style="display: unset;">Want to learn kitesurfing or take your tricks to the next level? Bonaire has some of the best kitesurfing schools, including Kiteboarding Bonaire and FX Kiteboarding. Whether you're a complete beginner or an advanced rider, their experienced instructors will have you on the water quickly and safely. No gear? No problem! Everything you need can be easily rented. After just a few lessons, you&rsquo;ll be gliding across the water with confidence.</span></p></div> 
</div>

 <div data-flex-id="6324fb8f" data-auto="flex-section" id="1934535858" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1064588942"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1421202150"></div> 
 <section id="2b5e2beb" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="9e5d2d07" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="0f6b406c" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="632d7387" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="c49d51e9" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1974265936"> <div class="dmNewParagraph skip-animation-effect skip-hover-effect" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1974265936" data-ai-tag="Short paragraph (2 sentences)" style=""> <h2><span style="display: initial;">Kitesurfing &amp; Staying at Windhoek Resort Bonaire</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="a630d532" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19" data-external-id="1996564223"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1996564223" data-ai-tag="Kicker" style=""><p><span style="display: initial;">Combine your kitesurfing adventure with a stay at the stylish Windhoek Resort Bonaire. This luxury boutique resort is not only a peaceful oasis, but it also offers kitesurfer-friendly facilities, such as secure gear storage. Plus, the resort is just minutes away from Bonaire&rsquo;s best kitesurfing spot. After a day on the water, unwind in a stunning Balinese-inspired setting, recharge, and get ready for another epic kitesurfing session.</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="89ed2604" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJlbnRyYW5jZSIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjEsImRlbGF5IjowLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsImRpciI6ImluLXBsYWNlIn19"></div>
